title: definitely worth downloading
body: it’s a very good app and helps a lot to have a better and healthy lifestyle. but some problems/limitations that i faced should be addressed with you. so firstly, it says “make a to-do list for tomorrow “, but it doesn’t give the option to create it within the app which is really annoying. secondly, if i set a timer for some task, it will only run when the app is opened, and the timer will stop when the app is closed…honestly, i was really disappointed with this. otherwise very good app and easy to use software. if more tasks are added, it would be the best app out there! thank you for reading till the end. hoping for a response soon.

title: Great
body: Great app, I have been using for years, but unfortunately it does not enable users to check habits manually. For example if I started a habit in the past before using the app, I can not manually check previous dates. In addition, If I miss checking a habit for any reason (forgetting for example) it will restart the counting, which is frustrating
